notes.title: Peaceful Days Progression (August 2025 Report)
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone,

It's been a really busy month for me. I've work really hard to improve the quality of the demo and make a lot of progress toward the 1.0 release.
Let see what I've achieved this month:
[b]1. A simple character customization system.[/b]
This is currently available in the demo. I just need to add more options for hair and outfit later.
[img src="https://i.ibb.co/JWdmd31L/Character-Customization.gif"][/img][b]2. A tracking system for NPC[/b]
This system is really useful for tracking NPC without having to always check the map yourself.[/p][previewyoutube="_ulRNFNuB5Y;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]3. Heart Events (4 out 8 done)
[/b]I've implemented half of the cutscene needed for the 1.0 release. Here is one of them. *Spoiler alert*[/p][previewyoutube="-rHSTaazvsw;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]4. Encyclopedia
[/b]I added an encyclopedia for the game. This will be useful for 100% run.
[img src="https://i.ibb.co/ksbH5tjh/Encyclopedia.gif"][/img][b]5. Enviroments
[/b]I added more stuff to the enviroment like birds, butterfly, firefly, etc... This will make the world more beautiful.
[img src="https://i.ibb.co/JW1y0hrX/Enviroment.gif"][/img][b]6. Festivals
[/b]All festivals are implemented in the game! You can participate up to 3 festivals per season.
[img src="https://i.ibb.co/ymZJHvsq/Christmas-Day2.gif"][/img][b]6. Many more! 
- [/b]I updated many QoL features like having a bubble to display the product on the animal so you don't have to use your tool to check on them, so you don't miss out. 
- Update the fishing minigame. Add camera adjustment option so you can adjust to your liking and more more...  

Alright, that's all for this month report! 
Althought the demo release is not a success. Only 200+ people played it. 
This game is really important to me and if you have time, please give the demo a try and leave a review on the demo page for me. This will help me a lot. 
Play the demo here:
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3912930/Peaceful_Days_Demo/"][/dynamiclink] Thanks for reading and see you again next month!  


[b]Nhat Nguyen[/b][/p]

notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Happy New Year 2025! It's time for the February report.

First, I’m sorry to share some difficult news, but I want to be honest with you. I was recently diagnosed with Chronic Kidney Disease at the age of 26. That explains why I’ve been dealing with so many headaches and other health issues. But don’t worry—I’m doing fine now, and I’m staying focused. Finishing this game is still my top priority, no matter what.

Enough with the sad story—let’s dive into the game progress!

This month, I’ve been recovering and managed to find some time to work on a few things.

Winter season assets have been implemented. I love the cozy winter vibes so much that I spent quite a bit of time just wandering around. Also, you can still plant crops in winter!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Pwg4Djd.png[/img]

The biggest update this month is the completion of indoor maps! My artist and I worked hard to enhance the visuals and improve clarity. I hope you’ll enjoy exploring them.

notes.title: Peaceful Days Progression (December 2024 Report)
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

It’s time for the December progression report!

I’ve accomplished quite a lot this month. Before diving in, I want to share some sad news. As I’m writing this, I’m in the hospital. Thankfully, I managed to upload everything I needed for this devlog beforehand. I didn’t think I’d be able to post anything this month, but I was so excited to share my progress with you. Unfortunately, I had to visit the emergency room due to unexpected high blood pressure. Luckily, I didn’t suffer a stroke, and the doctors have everything under control. I’m still being monitored while they evaluate my condition.

No more sad news—let’s move on to this month’s devlog!

[h1]Ranching Update[/h1]
Animals have always been my favorite part of working on farming sim games. This month, I’ve implemented all the animals into the game, including exotic ones like herons and storks.

Storks and herons can both catch fish if you let them outside the day before, which is super convenient! Some of you may already have your own stork in the current build.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Xc3M3zF.png[/img]

I’ve added a flute that boosts your animals’ affection toward you!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3XhXOW5.gif[/img]

The bee system has been upgraded. In the current build, you can only build hives in predefined slots. Now, you can place them anywhere, even in the greenhouse.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/eymRUmU.gif[/img]

I’ve also upgraded the fish pond. You can now use it to increase the quality of your fish. Fish can produce eggs, which can be sold for more profit. Plus, you can raise clams to harvest pearls!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/DKur1jg.gif[/img]

[h1]Farm Buildings[/h1]
I’ve implemented nearly every buildable structure for the farm. The greenhouse is one of the highlights. I’ll let you discover the rest on your own later!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/7aGRSiF.png[/img]

Each greenhouse comes with a built-in sprinkler system, which is extremely useful as it doesn’t take up valuable space like regular sprinklers.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/id5uGbU.png[/img]

[h1]Others[/h1]
These features deserve their own categories, but I’m short on time, so I’ll leave them here.

I’ve improved the wallpaper and flooring system! You can now customize each room with your favorite combinations. There are 20+ unique options for both, and I plan to add more during the polishing phase.
[previewyoutube=6YsIQNEcjtk;full][/previewyoutube]

Introducing the Sticky Label, an item you can buy from the local grocery store to mark your chests. This will be helpful when you have multiple chests, so you don’t have to rely on memory. I might extend this feature in the future to mark other objects—suggestions are welcome!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/97fn2ZN.gif[/img]

I’ve overhauled the How to Play section. It’s now easier to use and navigate!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/58gYG9n.png[/img]

I also added a new secret location.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/zZbPCJv.gif[/img]

That’s pretty much everything worth sharing this month. There’s definitely more, but I don’t want this post to get too lengthy. I’m enjoying every moment of my game development journey, though I’m unsure when I’ll be able to return to it. I’ll keep you updated about my health on my X account.

Thank you for your continued support—it’s been a great source of strength for me. I’m going to take some rest now, and I wish you all a wonderful New Year!

Thank you for reading, and see you next time!

Nhat Nguyen

notes.title: Peaceful Days Progression (November 2024 Report)
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

It's time for the November progression report!

I must say, this has been the most successful month I've had in a while. Let's go over what I accomplished this month.

[h1]Mining[/h1]
First of all, I’ve finished the mining system and overhauled the puzzles. This took a lot of time, but I’m glad to have done it. I hope it will be much better compared to the current system.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/hJRjC1g.gif[/img]
I also added many cool items to enhance your mining journey.
Take a look at this Ore Detector!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/5TEJCnm.gif[/img]

[h1]Skill System[/h1]
There’s now a skill system I’ve always wanted to add in the old build but never got the chance to. With better planning, I’ve introduced a system where you can unlock interesting perks.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/my65ZZH.png[/img]

[h1]Quest System[/h1]
People seem to love completing quests, so I revamped the system to make it look much better. The core system remains the same, but the new design allows me to add more types of quests in the future.
[previewyoutube=OAwW4hf3kbg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Shop System[/h1]
The shop system also received an update, mainly focusing on UI/UX improvements.

(Please don’t ask why I talked to the nightstand to buy stuff...)

Lastly, there are a few minor tweaks here and there, but I’ll let you discover those on your own.

Thanks for reading, and see you next month!

Nhat Nguyen

Hello everyone, it's me again. 
As you can see, I've stopped push out new update for Peaceful Days for a while now. The most boring reason you will have to listen from me is the financial issue. Yes, the covid pandemic brought us too much trouble and I had to work fulltime + part-time for more than a year now just to cover all the living fees for my family. I just wish I could live my own dream making indie game full-time but life is life.
I hope you all can understand for me.

However, I just started working on Peaceful Days in a more professional way. Thanks to this, I can see a better picture about what I've done for my game and so, I can improve everything base on your new feedbacks.
Please tell me your idea here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1156360/discussions/0/2936867947864414347/
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35801251/21fda5335046526369e1df7bb3546f9a864d8ef7.png[/img]

Thank you for your supporting!

notes.title: September Update
notes.content:
Hello, it's me again. I just want to say I love this community so much. Your kind words helped me get through a difficult time.
These are the thing I have been doing in September.
[list]
[*]House Upgrade
The old house was hard to implement so I just created a new one. Added quest for a free house upgrade and other cool stuff.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35801251/f942e002885de236060df3d9d30eeeb694950df5.gif[/img]
[*]Inventory
Okay, now you can have multiple stacks of the same item. And you can swap things in your bag too!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35801251/7bb1dfe39fee8d4c9c7bef877d87edb213d00bae.gif[/img]
[*]Bee & Honey
The old system was boring, so I changed it. You can now plant trees around the hives. Each type of tree will give you a specific type of honey. The quality of the honey will also increase when you harvest.
Try to plant 3 different types of trees around one hive, and you will get Special Honey!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35801251/84d96296c0a88214847e179786bfd3ada6072bc0.png[/img]
[*]Exhibition Room
Robert had an idea to attract more people to the town so he asked you to complete the collection
of items...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35801251/efde40da7b7b79fb29b046ef6ce8f65a04e272bc.png[/img]
[*]Quick Save (WIP)
Yes, you can save without going back to your house now. But there are some limitations. 
Ex: Can't save in the Mine.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35801251/43f21963fee4aa8c0e6e7f1eb4c0c2629c2ee838.png[/img]
[*]Fence Gate
It's useful so I just added one.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35801251/7e9d54ef83daf0373946d766f2ecb7eaf93f0dce.gif[/img]
[*]Fixed a lotta bug that I don't even remember...
[/list]

This list could be longer but due to the storm hit my place and there was no electricity for 3 days.
Thanks for reading and have a good day!

notes.title: Update 0.6.0
notes.content:
It's been a while since I last updated the game. I was having some health issues for a few week ago but I'm still working on the game :P
The update bring some Qol update as well as adding more contents and bug fixings.
Here is a list of the changes:
[list]
[*] Added more mine floors, mineral stones, puzzles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35801251/3a2af237f4ecaf1c27544e65c49f2af54f89edbd.png[/img]
[*] Improved mouse system. Now the game will show item name
  when your hover on the hot bar and show NPC name
  when you hover on them in the minimap.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35801251/5e5d21520653f69936871845f28204f3dad6159e.gif[/img]
[*] Added "Animal Flute". With this flute, you
  can make your animal happier (Have 50% chance to give 
  addition products). (Still need more testing)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35801251/492fdde9fa6f0edaff89d454d7912935c691a01f.gif[/img]

  one crop.
[*] Can now unequip tool when you select that tool again on the hot bar.
[*] Fixed time-base events bug.
[*] Fixed a bug that can make you can't move when finish 
  loading the game.
[*] Added mouse support for name choosing scene.
[*] Fixed a lot of minor bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: Mouse Support & QoL Updates
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35801251/712474241923846be14c5f52c5b0526cb415b06b.gif[/img]
Spent almost yesterday and today to work on mouse support and QoL update such as:
[list]
[*]Added a hot bar for quick selecting tools, items.
[*]Added an option to lock player direction after using (Hoe, Watering Can, Seeds). This will help a lot, I think.

It doesn't work in character creation, name selection scene. I will try to improve this in the future updates.

notes.title: Chinese Language Support!
notes.content:
After a few weeks of testing, we can release language support for Chinese players now!
You will be asked to choose game language when you start the game.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Rlr2uZz.png[/img]
Or you can change the language via ingame menu. Easy!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/kNYwalO.png[/img]
I know it still has some small issues but our localizing team is improving everyday.
By the way, if someone want to translate the game into another languages, please contract me via Twitter or by my email. (dsiver144@gmail.com)

Thank you so much for your support!
